annotation.title_clean: 商务部办公厅关于组织开展2025年千县万镇新能源汽车消费季活动的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the Ministry of Commerce on Organizing the 2025 Thousand Counties and Ten Thousand Towns New Energy Vehicle Consumption Season
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 商务部办公厅 (General Office of the Ministry of Commerce)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Commerce notice organizing a July–December 2025 new energy vehicle consumption campaign in counties and towns, promoting trade-ins, charging infrastructure and consumer protection. It briefly calls for steady commercialization of advanced intelligent-driving vehicles under safe, controllable and lawful conditions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Runs July–December 2025 with local NEV consumption events and trade-in zones
Steadily advance commercialization of high-level intelligent driving vehicles, safe, controllable and lawful
Build rural charging, parking, after-sales and recycling infrastructure
Resist involution competition and strengthen consumer rights protection
China Automobile Dealers Association to promote industry self-discipline and compliance
